title: Handheld LCD
when: Games, retro technology, step-by-step logic, levels and progress: a story played on a 1989 screen

voice.style: playful and quick, like a narrator who has played this level before

rules: Four shades only: bg, surface, accent2 and ink. Every shape is laid in pixels (the canvas mosaic default); outlines are pixel edges in the stroke colour.
Motion is stepped (12 frames a second on moving elements) and moves in whole cells: sprites hop, they do not glide.
Build the world in screens: one screen per beat, the camera cutting (or a world pan) as the player moves right. Start from pixel-skyline.
Labels are short mono caps, like a status bar: LEVEL 2, 3/5, GAME OVER. Real figures still carry a source line.
Give the screen depth with a shadow under moving sprites (shadow: {dx: 3, dy: 3, blur: 0, opacity: 0.25}).
